gen-gf-noto-serif-lao-work-sans: Work Sans reads open and modern, its c tips held well apart and its mean line sitting high. And Noto Serif Lao gives it a traditional counterpart, with thicks and thins in moderation and bowls that swell only slightly.
gen-gf-noto-serif-makasar-archivo: Noto Serif Makasar has lowercase letters swollen like coiled rope, with rounded forms that thicken at their sides, and Archivo sits beneath with a commanding x-height. The serif and the sans-serif feel clearly different.
gen-gf-noto-serif-makasar-fs-asap: Asap reads readable and sturdy, its c forms open arcs and its lowercase nearly matching the capitals in height. Noto Serif Makasar does the stroke contrast, slight but noticeable, while Asap simply keeps the line moving.
gen-gf-noto-serif-makasar-fs-epilogue: Wiry and loose, Epilogue has curvy letters, a tall-bodied lowercase and stubby ascender tips, under a heading with calm weight shifts. Noto Serif Makasar and Epilogue differ most in stroke.
gen-gf-noto-serif-makasar-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans reads crisp and technical, with wide-ended s curves and a larger-than-usual x-height drawn like a pen on a technical drawing. But Noto Serif Makasar rises and falls in thickness, a calm ebb and flow the sans never attempts.
gen-gf-noto-serif-makasar-fs-public-sans: Public Sans reads hefty and trustworthy, its lowercase solid and its counters on c and s broad. And Noto Serif Makasar above it keeps a restful line, so a long page would move at an unhurried pace.
gen-gf-noto-serif-makasar-fs-supreme: Supreme brings a thick, heavy-looking strip of text through the middle of each line. Noto Serif Makasar adds moderate contrast, neither stark nor flat, so the heavier body feels held open and lightly literary beside it.
gen-gf-noto-serif-makasar-general-sans: Literary in feel, Noto Serif Makasar tempers its thick-thin variation and never reaches razor-fine hairlines. And General Sans answers with a tube-like, constant-width stroke whose x-height fills the line, giving the page two clear voices.
gen-gf-noto-serif-makasar-manrope: Manrope reads bright and clean, with an open gap at every curve's mouth and barely any step from capital to lowercase. Noto Serif Makasar earns its keep when set big and short.
gen-gf-noto-serif-makasar-montserrat: Noto Serif Makasar shows light but visible stroke variation, with lowercase swollen like rope coiled tight, above Montserrat's geometric form. A longer read would glide under the eye like wire.
